final_topology.title: Government Segmented Network
final_topology.description: A network with distinct zones for standard and sensitive information systems, each with dedicated administrative infrastructure.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes separate zones for standard and sensitive systems, each with its own administrative infrastructure. The standard zone has a secure internet gateway, while the sensitive zone is isolated and protected by a Class 1 gateway.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management System' node (n_new1) that is linked to various nodes across different zones, indicating asset tracking and management.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation Zone Management Service' node (n_struct3) in the 'Data Flow Documentation Zone' (z9), indicating the presence of data flow documentation.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for 'Standard Systems' (z1) and 'Sensitive Systems' (z2), each with its own administrative infrastructure (z3 and z4).

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n1, n2, n5, n6) in various zones, indicating the implementation of firewalls on servers.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n11) in the 'Internet Gateway Zone' (z5), which is linked to the 'Secure Internet Gateway' (n5), indicating the configuration of trusted DNS servers.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Service' node (n_new2) in the 'MFA Service Zone' (z_new2), which is linked to the 'Remote Access Zone Security Gateway' (n_struct4) in the 'Remote Access Zone' (z10).

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filtering Service' node (n12) in the 'Internet Gateway Zone' (z5), which is linked to the 'Secure Internet Gateway' (n5).

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' node (n13) in the 'Internet Gateway Zone' (z5), which is linked to the 'Secure Internet Gateway' (n5), indicating the enforcement of network-based URL filters.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for standard and sensitive systems, each with its own administrative infrastructure, and a secure internet gateway, indicating a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Centralized AAA Server' (n14) in the 'Standard Admin Zone' (z3), which is linked to various nodes, indicating secure management of network infrastructure.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Centralized AAA Server' (n14) in the 'Standard Admin Zone' (z3), which is linked to various nodes, indicating centralized AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'VPN Service' node (n_new3) in the 'VPN Service Zone' (z_new3), which is linked to the 'Remote Access Zone Security Gateway' (n_struct4) and the 'Centralized AAA Server' (n14), indicating the use of a VPN and connection to the AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes dedicated 'Standard Admin Workstation' (n3) and 'Sensitive Admin Workstation' (n4) nodes in their respective administrative zones (z3 and z4), indicating dedicated computing resources for administrative work.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS' node (n15) in the 'Standard Systems Zone' (z1), which is linked to the 'Standard Router' (n7), indicating the deployment of a network intrusion detection solution.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n1, n2, n5, n6) and routers (n7, n8) that are linked between different zones, indicating traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Access Control Policy' node (n_new4) in the 'Remote Access Zone' (z10), which is linked to the 'Remote Access Zone Security Gateway' (n_struct4), indicating the management of access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'SIEM' node (n19) in the 'Standard Admin Zone' (z3), which is linked to the 'NIDS' (n15), 'NIPS' (n16), and 'Application Firewall' (n17), indicating the collection of network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIPS' node (n16) in the 'Standard Systems Zone' (z1), which is linked to the 'Standard Router' (n7), indicating the deployment of a network intrusion prevention solution.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes an '802.1X Controller' node (n18) in the 'Standard Systems Zone' (z1), which is linked to the 'Standard Switch' (n9), indicating the deployment of port-level access control.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Firewall' node (n17) in the 'Standard Systems Zone' (z1), which is linked to the 'Standard Router' (n7), indicating the performance of application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Systems Zone' (z6) that is peered with the 'Standard Systems Zone' (z1), indicating the separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Pen Test Frequency' node (n_new5) in the 'External Penetration Testing Zone' (z_preserve1), which is linked to the 'Remote Access Zone Security Gateway' (n_struct4), indicating the performance of periodic external penetration tests.

findings_before.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure

findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of a VPN or connection to the AAA infrastructure.

findings_before.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets

findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic testing.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node or label indicating the frequency of external penetration tests and link it to the External Penetration Testing Zone.
